National Emergency Management Agency
Emergency Management Act
The Emergency Management Act 2026 creates the legal framework for emergency management in New Zealand. It replaced the Civil Defence Emergency Management Act 2002 (CDEM Act).
Coordinated Incident Management System (CIMS) third edition
The Coordinated Incident Management System (CIMS) 3rd edition represents New Zealand’s official framework to achieve effective co-ordinated incident management across responding agencies.
Emergency preparedness
Emergencies can happen anytime, anywhere. It’s up to you to take steps to make sure you’re prepared.

Training and development
Find information about training and courses offered by the National Emergency Management Agency and other providers, access the takatū learning management system, and learn about the CDEM Competency Framework.

21 Oct 2026
NZ ShakeOut 2026: Don’t go for the doorway! Why science says we’re getting earthquakes wrong
Nearly half of people in New Zealand would take unnecessary risks in an earthquake and could pay with their lives, the National Emergency Management Agency Te Rākau Whakamarumaru (NEMA) says.
21 Oct 2026
Annual Report 2025/26 now published
The National Emergency Management Agency's Annual Report 2025/26 is now available on the Department of Internal Affairs website as part of the Department's Annual Report.
